# Project Phoenix v56.0 — Mongol & East-Asian Steppe Khanate Portrait Fix.
# Generated by tools/gen_v560_mongol_and_era_portraits_fix.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Reuses Bamboo King's Community Flavor Pack portrait templates already integrated into Main Mod
# (oe_yp_genes_accessories.txt & oe_v49_genes_accessories.txt) plus verified vanilla templates.
# Character scope (portrait modifiers at priority = 104, selection_behavior = max).
# Uses ONLY vanilla culture_groups / graphical cultures / government_types + Main Mod oe_v49/oe_v495 helpers
# so Main Mod passes strict standalone engine audits and seamlessly governs all 12 eras (361-1821).

# Primary Mongol / Mongolic identity (mongol_gfx, mongolian_group, or east_asian_gfx + mongolian_coa_gfx).
# Yields non-horde Sibe (tungusic_group + mongolian_group) to oe_v49_jurchen_* so Manchu/Qing courts stay Jurchen.
oe_v56_is_mongol_primary = {
	OR = {
		oe_v49_is_mongol = yes
		AND = {
			gfx_culture_applicable = east_asian_gfx
			gfx_culture_applicable = mongolian_coa_gfx
		}
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = { oe_v49_is_jurchen_manchu = yes }
		any_ruling_countries = { government_type = government_type:steppe_horde }
		employer ?= { government_type = government_type:steppe_horde }
	}
}

# Non-Sinospheric east_asian_gfx steppe fallback (catches non-Mongol east_asian_gfx steppe hordes &
# steppe_group cultures without touching Chinese, Korean, Vietnamese, Japanese, Jurchen/Manchu, or Muslim attire).
oe_v56_is_east_asian_steppe_fallback = {
	gfx_culture_applicable = east_asian_gfx
	NOT = { oe_v56_is_mongol_primary = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_jurchen_manchu = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_japanese = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_chinese_group = yes }
	NOT = { culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:confucian_group } }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = indochina_gfx }
	NOT = { portrait_religion_clothing_trigger = { RELIGION_FLAG = muslim_gfx } }
	OR = {
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:steppe_group }
		any_ruling_countries = { government_type = government_type:steppe_horde }
		employer ?= { government_type = government_type:steppe_horde }
	}
}

# --- MALE MONGOL & EAST-ASIAN STEPPE HIERARCHY ---

# 1. Mongol Great Khans, Regional Khans & Royal Heirs -> Mongol Imperial Hat + Mongol Imperial Robe
#    (MGE, OIR, KHA, GLH, CHG, ILK, post-fall YUA, Qara Khitai, Xianbei, Rouran; preserves oe_yp for unfallen CHI
#    and preserves vanilla war armor when is_general = yes via oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male).
oe_v56_mongol_khan_high = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	oe_v56_is_mongol_primary = yes
	OR = {
		any_ruling_countries = { country_rank_level >= 3 }
		any_ruling_countries = { government_type = government_type:steppe_horde }
		is_heir = yes
	}
}

# 2. Mongol Noyans, Cabinet, Regents, Minor Rulers & East-Asian-GFX Steppe Horde Rulers/Cabinet -> Fur Cap + High Steppe Robe
oe_v56_mongol_steppe_noble_high = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	NOT = { oe_v56_mongol_khan_high = yes }
	OR = {
		oe_v56_is_mongol_primary = yes
		oe_v56_is_east_asian_steppe_fallback = yes
	}
	OR = {
		is_ruler = yes
		in_cabinet = yes
		is_regent = yes
		is_heir = yes
	}
}

# 3. Mongol Lower Nobles/Courtiers & East-Asian-GFX Steppe Horde Courtiers -> Fur Cap + Low Steppe Robe
oe_v56_mongol_steppe_noble_low = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	NOT = { oe_v56_mongol_khan_high = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v56_mongol_steppe_noble_high = yes }
	OR = {
		oe_v56_is_mongol_primary = yes
		oe_v56_is_east_asian_steppe_fallback = yes
	}
}

# --- FEMALE MONGOL & EAST-ASIAN STEPPE KHATUNS ---

# 4. Islamic Mongol Empresses, Consorts & Dowager Regents (Rank 4 Monarchy: GLH, ILK, CHG after Islamization)
#    Overrides priority-103 oe_v495_female_east_asian_empress so Muslim Mongol empresses wear Islamic imperial attire.
oe_v56_female_mongol_islamic_empress = {
	oe_v495_female_portrait_eligible = yes
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_unfallen_yuan_court = yes }
	oe_v56_is_mongol_primary = yes
	portrait_religion_clothing_trigger = { RELIGION_FLAG = muslim_gfx }
	oe_v495_female_is_rank4_monarchy = yes
}

# 5. Islamic Mongol Queens, Consorts & Dowager Regents (Rank 3 Monarchy)
oe_v56_female_mongol_islamic_queen = {
	oe_v495_female_portrait_eligible = yes
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_unfallen_yuan_court = yes }
	oe_v56_is_mongol_primary = yes
	portrait_religion_clothing_trigger = { RELIGION_FLAG = muslim_gfx }
	NOT = { oe_v495_female_is_rank4_monarchy = yes }
	oe_v495_female_is_rank3_monarchy = yes
}

# 6. Non-Muslim Mongol & East-Asian-GFX Steppe Khatuns (headwear-only override to no_headwear)
#    Strips anachronistic Ming/Han imperial phoenix cap (female_headwear_chinese_royalty_cap) from
#    steppe Khatuns while keeping natural braided hairstyles and belted royal silk robes.
oe_v56_female_mongol_steppe_khatun = {
	oe_v495_female_portrait_eligible = yes
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_unfallen_yuan_court = yes }
	NOT = { portrait_religion_clothing_trigger = { RELIGION_FLAG = muslim_gfx } }
	OR = {
		oe_v56_is_mongol_primary = yes
		oe_v56_is_east_asian_steppe_fallback = yes
	}
}
